title: Internal force kernel emission
objective: Emit Taichi kernel for deformation gradient computation, constitutive call, and force scatter.
implementation_steps: Emit deformation gradient computation: F = I + du/dX using Hex8 shape function gradients
Emit constitutive model call (SVK stress from P6.3)
Emit internal force scatter: f_int = integral(B^T S dV)
Use Gauss quadrature from P6.1 tables
Verify with single-element patch test against reference solver
acceptance_criteria: Single-element patch test passes against reference solver output (P1.1)
Force kernel uses correct quadrature and shape functions
Mesh indices are runtime loops, physics indices are ti.static

cases: Force vector symmetry for symmetric loading

risks: B-matrix assembly errors can silently produce wrong forces — verify with patch test
